name: Texas Eastern TIME II Expansion Phase 1

values.OtherEnglishNames: Texas Eastern Incremental Market Expansion II Phase 1; TETCO TIME II Expansion Phase 1

researcher_notes: EIA August 2026 release, Sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 468, project 'TETCO TIME II Expansion Phase 1': completed Nov 2007, 21.64 mi new 36-inch pipe, 150 MMcf/d added, cost 116.7 million USD, FERC docket CP06-115, states listed PA, WV, NJ. No existing row matches: the Texas Eastern rows are the main line P0262 (14,202 mi, no segment detail), TEAM 2012/2014/2021, TEAL, OPEN, TEMAX (cancelled) and others, none named TIME II. Length meets the 25 km rule (21.64 mi is about 34.8 km). Weaknesses: single source (EIA is one origin) and the FERC order for CP06-115 could not be read this session because web search hit a usage limit, so loop locations and whether the 21.64 mi are all new pipe are unconfirmed. EIA states Phase 2 (OH, WV, PA, NJ, 10.27 mi, 2008) under the same docket, which is under 25 km and would be monitor. StartState/EndState taken from EIA state list order (PA to NJ per consolidator); WV also listed, so endpoints need the FERC order. Owner entity_lookup hit: Texas Eastern Transmission LP. Start year recorded from the completed date; no route found, so RouteType unavailable. Next step: pair with the FERC CP06-115 order or an operator release before staging.
